notes.title: 26.06.2025 Update Notes
notes.content:
[b]The issue where the Apply button didn't apply the settings has been fixed.

The misalignment of button hitboxes after pressing the Apply button has been corrected.

Labels above the boxes have been fixed.

Improperly scaled background images have been corrected.

Text overflowing outside the UI in different languages has been resolved.

Products have been renamed.

The screen layout issue caused by closing the list while on the computer screen has been fixed.[/b]

notes.title: 18.05.2025 Update Notes
notes.content:
[b][list]
[*] Map boundaries for NPCs have been adjusted.
 
[*] Fixed issues with unnatural NPC movement.

[*] Fixed a bug where the NPC wouldn't take the trash to the trash can.
 
[*] Missing UI elements related to interactable objects have been added.

[*] Fixed hover-related issues during interactions with PCs.

[*] A guide button has been added to both the main menu and the pause menu.

[*] The house door is now interactable.

[*] Fixed an issue where money could go negative when ordering food.

[*] Various bugs related to loading and saving have been fixed.

[*] Improvements have been made to the loading process.

[*] Fixed an issue where ordered items would spawn overlapping each other.

[*] A sign has been added to open and close the shop
[/list][/b]

notes.title: Update Notes 11.05.2025
notes.content:
[b]1-Some bugs related to the load and save system have been fixed.[/b]
[b]2-Some informative UIs have been added for interactable objects.[/b]
[b]3-The stamina bar is now active; when stamina drops to 0, money loss and screen darkening are triggered.[/b]
[b]4-The position and angle of the interactable baseball bat have been adjusted.[/b]
[b]5-Various bugs related to the day-night cycle have been fixed.[/b]
[b]6-Performed minor performance optimizations related to the map.[/b]
